text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One evening, while Mejiro Bright and I are strolling around town…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Oooh, what's going on over there? There are quite a lot of people. Is it some kind of ceremony?

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Step right up and try your luck with our New Year's raffle! This year's grand prize is a hot spring vacation for two!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: First-prize winners get a deluxe carrot hamburger steak! Second-prize winners get a bushel of carrots! And third-prize winners can take home a single carrot!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Don't let this opportunity pass you by! You there, the quiet Umamusume in the back! Care to give it a try?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Oh, may I? I would gladly.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: But… pardon me, Trainer. Don't we need tickets to try the raffle?
choice_data_list: I've got the five we need right here.
I've got the five we need right here.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Oh my, I should have known you'd come prepared. Let's try our luck five times, then.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Actually, we can only try once, but I decide to keep that to myself for now.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Now then, Trainer. Place your hand on mine and let's spin this mini Ferris wheel.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Annnd… spiiiiin. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She turns the handle in super slow motion, but eventually, a ball falls out…

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Holy mackerel! We've got ourselves a grand-prize winner! Come and get the ticket for your hot spring vacation! Congratulations!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Goodness. What an incredible turn of events.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: To think we would win a hot spring… I don't own one myself, but I have made use of the one at the Mejiro estate before.
choice_data_list: Well, it's not a hot spring. It's a vacation to a hot spring.
Well, it's not a hot spring. It's a vacation to a hot spring.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A hot spring isn't something you could win as a grand prize. Still, what we did get is pretty incredible.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: A hot spring vacation. ♪ I think it would be in our best interest to go as soon as we can, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: If we begin preparing once we arrive back on campus… Let's see… I believe I will be ready by…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: January of next year.
choice_data_list: Wow, that's a long prep time…
Wow, that's a long prep time…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Is it? But it's only natural that it would take so long, considering I'll be racing during the same period.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: That sounds about right for Mejiro Bright. If she's doing two things at once, it'll take a whole year.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Hmm. Do you have any plans a year from now?
choice_data_list: I don't think so.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: That means we can go on this trip together. What a relief.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Could you hold onto the coupon until then? I'm looking forward to a warm, relaxing hot spring bath next year.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her excitement is written all over her face. Mejiro Bright's cheeks grow pink, as if she's already entered the hot water.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Looks like we have another first-prize winner! Congratulations! You get one deluxe carrot hamburger steak!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Oh my, it looks scrumptious! Can you believe how big it is?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Trainer, would you entrust me with the task of cooking it?
choice_data_list: …Can you?
…Can you?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I can. For it to come out best, you have to cook it long and slow for the heat to properly pass through.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: In other words, I have the perfect personality for preparing it.
choice_data_list: Tell me how you'll actually cook it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: That is the question. I'll lightly heat up a frying pan and then let the hamburger steak cook on a low flame…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: For about two hours. ♪
choice_data_list: That'll burn it!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Oh, will it? I'm not so adept at precision…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She decides to leave the cooking duties to me. Back at Tracen Academy, we later enjoy a tender hamburger steak.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: We got a second-prize winner! It's your lucky day! You're going home with a bushel of carrots!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Oh dearie. It'll take hours to peel all these.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: However, I did do a splendid job of peeling daikon radishes before.
choice_data_list: Ah, so you're a peeling pro.
Ah, so you're a peeling pro.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I'm not sure I'd go that far, but I managed to cut the skin nice and thin, I believe.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: In the end, the whole daikon radish became one loooong sheet of skin.
choice_data_list: That's incredible!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her pace may be slow, but you could never call her untalented.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: If you'd like, I'm sure I could also peel the carrots the same way…
choice_data_list: Don't worry about it. We can just eat them as is.
Don't worry about it. We can just eat them as is.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It would be a waste of time to peel them all. Instead, we just boil them and eat them that way. I've never tasted sweeter carrots.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Would you lookie here! You've won the third prize! Here's your carrot!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: One carrot… You have my apologies. We were unable to draw a decent prize because of me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Since there's only one, I can't help but want to eat it right away.
choice_data_list: How about you eat it while we walk home?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: That won't work, I'm afraid. I'm not adept at walking and chewing at the same time.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I'm simply incapable. I always end up stopping in place…
choice_data_list: How about we relax over there then?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Oh, this is a nice spot. We can even watch the sunset here.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Let's split the carrot, Trainer. Look, it's the same color as the sun!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We nibble our halves of the carrot while watching the sun set over the horizon. The carrot is heartwarmingly sweet.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Ohhh, tough luck! Looks like you pulled a blank one! Take this pack of tissues as a consolation prize.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Sigh… Tissues. And there's barely any in here…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: You could go through a pack this size in no time. Trainer, you agree, yes? We need more tissues?
choice_data_list: Uh, sure…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Then as an apology for such an unworthy prize, I will have more sent to you from the Mejiro estate.
choice_data_list: Thanks. That would be helpful.
Thanks. That would be helpful.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: You'll receive one truckload.
choice_data_list: I don't need that many!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Is that so? But I don't know if any less would compensate for my failure today…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She lowers her head apologetically. I can't believe a little raffle could end on such a somber note…
